provenance.platform: Windows 11, Intel i7-1355U (2 P-cores + 8 E-cores, 12 logical), CPU only, UNPINNED -- deliberately not the 8-core affinity the 2026-08-23 reading used; see the speed caveat below.
provenance.note: The FIRST reading of the redrawn, sealed holdout, and the first genuinely held-out number since v1.13.0. all2md ran the PMC lane parser policy (layout analysis enabled, OCR auto); baselines ran their defaults at the versions baselines.txt pins -- unchanged from the two previous readings, so the baseline side is held fixed and the corpus is what moved. Every tool's markdown was re-parsed through all2md's markdown parser before scoring, so all three share one normalization path; reparse_word_ratio is 0.99/1.04/0.96, so the re-parse is not eating any tool's content. Tesseract is installed on this box but not on PATH; that is moot and measured rather than assumed -- 0 of the corpus's 1,115 pages carry a text layer under 20 characters, so all2md's auto-OCR has nothing to fire on. It fired 0 times; pymupdf4llm fired 432.
provenance.speed_caveat: seconds_per_article_mean is NOT comparable to the 2026-08-23 reading and should not be quoted against it. All three tools measured 1.8-2.5x slower than their own records in this session. That is not a regression: all2md v1.13.0, built from its tag in a worktree, measured within 2% of HEAD on the same nine articles in the same session. Two unrelated third-party tools drifting the same direction points at ambient machine state -- the earlier reading ran overnight on an idle laptop, this one shared the box -- and a 15W U-series part throttles under sustained ONNX load. The RELATIVE ordering is robust and is what this column is good for: all2md remains the fastest of the three by 1.7x over pymupdf4llm and 3.0x over docling. Absolute values are a property of the machine that day. Note also that pinning to logical cores 0-7 on this hybrid CPU costs a further 2.3x on the ONNX layout path.
provenance.control: The false-positive control holds for every tool: control_recall is 0.0042 / 0.0049 / 0.0044 against attainable recall near 0.97, so the instrument is not crediting text that is not there. No conversion failures and no parse failures for any tool.
provenance.in_sample_warning: The 2026-08-19 and 2026-08-23 readings in this directory were measured on what is now benchmarks/pmc/manifest-tuned.json, which had been tuned against. They are in-sample. Movement between them and this reading confounds a corpus change with a code change and must not be read as progress or regression.
